parameter_scope_notes.T003: Main Fig. 3 and Supplement Fig. S2 endpoint mutual information, dense full spectra through L=14 and matrix-free eigenstate subsets at L=16/18.

scheduler.recommended_machine: High-memory multicore CPU nodes; A100 may accelerate a separately validated dense or matrix-free backend, but is not assumed by this contract.
scheduler.resume_identity: Each atomic result is bound to configuration SHA-256, implementation SHA-256 and canonical work-unit SHA-256.

acceptance_criteria: All deterministic work units finish exactly once or resume from digest-matched atomic shards; aggregation refuses missing or stale shards.
Every one of the 38 numeric items in the main paper and supplement is produced from the published Floquet model or the explicitly disclosed independent protocol reconstruction.
Trace, level-ratio, mutual-information and variance invariants pass; all generated numerical arrays are hashed in the final manifest before rendering.
The numerical path reads no raw paper assets, reference images, author code, author numerical arrays, digitized curves or source pixels.
Unpublished sampling grids, seeds, phase-boundary weights and the Supplement S1 susceptibility interpretation remain reconstructed and cannot be promoted to paper-exact without further evidence.
A stable disagreement is classified through protocol-v2 falsification and fresh-context review; execution failure alone never becomes a paper-error claim.
